quote: Calm an enemy, disarming their melee and ranged weapons for $d.
name: Calm (an enemy player's Auto Shots stop)

enemy_shooter.source: Witch Hunter (class 15) with the crossbow of the 'Boltslinger' set of witch_hunter.json (item 15809, slot 17, skill line 226). Control: the same enemy shoots 5000 ms with no Calm on it; the trial is void unless it fired at least one Auto Shot (SPELL_GO of 75) there.

observe_source: Calm 804057 Effect[1] aura 67 MOD_DISARM and Effect[2] aura 254 MOD_DISARM_OFFHAND, no aura 278 (DBC read 2026-11-22). Enemy player race 2. Calm on a player (not Undead or Demon) refuses its own Effect[0] trigger 807778 with reason 27 (SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT): that refusal is native to the cast and is stated in native_refusals; any other refusal voids the ranged trial. Auto Shot 75 SPELL_GO count of the enemy: the control window (no Calm) must read at least 1 (crossbow speed 2800 ms, so at least 1 in 5000 ms), and the window with Calm on the enemy (1000 ms + 4500 ms, the aura read first) must add 0 shots (the tooltip says ranged weapons are disarmed). The only consumer of UNIT_FLAG2_DISARM_RANGED is Unit::CanUseAttackType(RANGED_ATTACK) (Unit.h:1004). Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip, the DBC and the engine code cited.
